messages.text: Our top desktop pick is the Frank L. Wright Collection BARREL Bronze Metallic Desktop Globe — a bronze metallic finish, hand-assembled heirloom piece that makes a real statement on a desk or credenza. What's the globe for: your own workspace, or a gift for someone?
16 inch ocean blue Lake Ontario and Gulf of Mexico

Good news on the maps: ours is labeled Gulf of Mexico, and the Great Lakes keep their usual names like Lake Ontario — no Gulf of America or Lake America here.

For a 16-inch blue ocean desktop globe, the top pick is the National Geographic Nicollet 16" Illuminated Desk Globe in Blue Ocean. It's a bigger desktop piece with that classic bright, crisp blue-ocean look, and it illuminates to reveal more detail at night. Is this one for your own desk, or a gift?
using as part of a sculpture and it rotates 360 degrees and electrical may be an issue

The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe with its Black Metal Gyromatic Base is a great fit — the gyromatic mount lets it spin freely through a full rotation, and it has no cord or bulb to worry about, so it's completely self-contained for a sculpture piece. It keeps the same bright blue-ocean look and raised-relief detail you wanted. Want me to point you to that product page so you can add it to your cart?
is eureka 16 inch blue ocean available with Lake Ontario and Gulf of Mexico on the globe

Yes — all our maps, including the Eureka 16" Blue Ocean, use the traditional names: Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario, with no "Gulf of America" or "Lake America." You'll find it under "Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe - Black Metal Gyromatic Base" in search, ready to add to your cart.
